tokens.name: void-000
tokens.usage: Page ground. The dark the monoliths stand in; every screen starts here.

tokens.name: void-100
tokens.usage: Terminals and panels: session cards, player bar, stat grids.

tokens.name: void-200
tokens.usage: Raised controls: search fields, icon buttons, highlight cards.

tokens.name: void-300
tokens.usage: Top of a slab gradient (vault cards, album slabs); fades down into void-100.

tokens.name: line-100
tokens.usage: Row dividers inside lists (tracks, chapters). Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-200
tokens.usage: Section borders: header underline, panel outlines. Decorative only, never a control edge.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls (secondary buttons, inputs) and strata hairlines on slabs. 3:1+ on void-000 and void-100.

tokens.name: horizon
tokens.usage: The floor line monoliths stand on. One per hero; decorative.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on any void surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: synopses, artist names, metadata sentences.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Mono system labels, inactive nav, timestamps. Still 6:1+ on void-000.

tokens.name: on-seam
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a seam-coloured fill (primary buttons, active pills).

tokens.name: seam
tokens.usage: The brand light: the glowing seam, primary actions, focus rings, current item. Also the Music vault colour.

tokens.name: vault-music
tokens.usage: Music vault: albums, artists, tracks. Shares the brand seam colour. Use for seams, labels and progress in its screens.

tokens.name: vault-podcasts
tokens.usage: Podcasts vault: shows and episodes. Use for seams, labels and progress in its screens.

tokens.name: vault-video
tokens.usage: Video vault: films, series, home video. Use for seams, labels and progress in its screens.

tokens.name: vault-photos
tokens.usage: Photos vault: albums and timelines. Use for seams, labels and progress in its screens.

tokens.name: vault-books
tokens.usage: Books vault: ebooks. Use for seams, labels and progress in its screens.

tokens.name: vault-comics
tokens.usage: Comics vault: series and issues. Use for seams, labels and progress in its screens.

tokens.name: vault-games
tokens.usage: Games vault. Sealed until games are supported. Use for seams, labels and progress in its screens.

tokens.name: select-music
tokens.usage: Background of the current row in a music list, behind a vault-music left seam.

tokens.name: select-podcasts
tokens.usage: Background of the current row in a podcasts list, behind a vault-podcasts left seam.

tokens.name: select-video
tokens.usage: Background of the current row in a video list, behind a vault-video left seam.

tokens.name: select-photos
tokens.usage: Background of the current row in a photos list, behind a vault-photos left seam.

tokens.name: select-books
tokens.usage: Background of the current row in a books list, behind a vault-books left seam.

tokens.name: select-comics
tokens.usage: Background of the current row in a comics list, behind a vault-comics left seam.

tokens.name: select-games
tokens.usage: Background of the current row in a games list, behind a vault-games left seam.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per home hero. Uppercase, two short lines.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Item titles on detail screens; mobile hero.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card and session titles, sentence case.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Every song, film and book you own, held in one structure.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: List rows, controls, default UI text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: System labels: uppercase, often in a vault colour. Never for sentences.

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: The tide went out farther than any chart allowed.
styles.usage: Ebook body text in the reader. Max 640px measure.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gaps inside block-segment bars and icon pairs.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between buttons and nav items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Label-to-title gaps inside cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row padding; grid gaps on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; gaps between text blocks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on desktop; panel padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Space above section headings.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between major page sections.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: The default. Libralith is cut, not rounded: cards, buttons, inputs and panels are square or chamfered.

tokens.name: radius-disc
tokens.usage: Only for genuine discs: avatars and planet-like decoration. Never on controls.

chamfer.note: Corner cuts made with clip-path polygons. A chamfer cuts one corner (top-left) on slabs, or two opposite corners (top-left and bottom-right) on controls.

tokens.name: chamfer-s
tokens.usage: Icon buttons and mobile controls.

tokens.name: chamfer-m
tokens.usage: Primary buttons and search fields.

tokens.name: chamfer-l
tokens.usage: Vault cards and the video frame.

tokens.name: chamfer-xl
tokens.usage: Hero slabs and album art slabs.

stroke.note: Line weights. Light is drawn, never filled in large areas.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, strata on slabs, horizon lines.

tokens.name: stroke-seam
tokens.usage: The glowing seam, active-row left edge, progress bars.

shadow.note: Glows, not drop shadows. Pair a glow only with a seam-coloured element.

tokens.name: glow-seam
tokens.usage: The main seam on a hero monolith.

tokens.name: glow-soft
tokens.usage: Small seams on cards, progress bars, the active play button.

tokens.name: slab-drop
tokens.usage: Only for slabs that float above another surface.
